summary.description: One or two sentences: what was actually done. No preamble.

files_changed.description: Paths that were actually created or modified, relative to the repository root (e.g. 'app/src/main/java/Foo.kt'). Do NOT use absolute paths. Empty array if nothing was changed.

verification.description: How the work was checked and what was observed. Name the command run or the file re-read, and the actual result. If nothing was verified, say so plainly.

issues.description: Problems encountered, assumptions made, or work deliberately left undone. Empty array if none. Do not invent filler.

status.description: complete = the whole task is done; partial = some done, some not; blocked = could not proceed.
